seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, where to stay and how to get to Val Gardena in South Tyrol.

h1: Val Gardena ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Val Gardena runs up from Ortisei at 1,230 metres past Santa Cristina to Selva under the Sella, and it is the largest single area in the Dolomiti Superski table: 79 lifts and 129 slopes, open 4 December 2026 to 4 April 2027. Above it sits the Seiser Alm, at 56 square kilometres Europe's largest alpine pasture, which carries a snowpark with a park line of 1.5 kilometres and around 40 obstacles.
stayOverview: Three villages share the valley floor: Ortisei at the bottom with the pedestrian centre, Santa Cristina in the middle, and Selva at the top under the Sella passes.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Ortisei has the most to walk to; Selva puts you closest to the Sella Ronda circuit.
rentalCars: Val Gardena is about 40 kilometres from Bolzano, up its own side valley from the Isarco.

dayPass.value: Priced by date in three bands
dayPass.note: Dolomiti Superski prices the day pass by date - early and late-season promo, season, and high season - and publishes the rate only through its own price calculator, with 5% off online two days ahead. Its 2026/27 adult season pass is EUR 990 in advance sale to 24 December and EUR 1,060 after.
